name: Square to SAP — Integration Discovery Splash
intent: A premium enterprise landing page for defining an integration. It is a design workspace, not a live processing dashboard and not an official partnership page.

rules: Render vendor assets as images; never rebuild either logo with text or CSS.
Maintain clear space of at least the logo symbol width around each vendor mark.
Do not add partner, certified, approved or live-status language.

page.layout: brand lockup left; navigation and outlined CTA right

page.layoutDesktop: 12-column grid: copy 5 columns, 1-column gap, blueprint 6 columns
page.layoutMobile: single column: copy, actions, trust line, blueprint

headline: Every sale.
A bigger picture.
copy.description: Plan the connection between Square sales, SAP inventory and finance — with every decision, owner and mapping in one shared workspace.

blueprint.title: Integration blueprint
blueprint.disclaimer: Illustrative design — final interfaces depend on the approved SAP landscape and business process.
blueprint.visualBehavior: Use fine luminous connector paths with subtle directional pulses; disable animation under prefers-reduced-motion.

page.heading: Five decisions. One shared plan.
page.supportingCopy: Work through the key decisions to shape your integration, step by step.

interaction.hover: Raise interactive cards 2px and strengthen the cyan edge; never animate layout size.
interaction.motion: 180–260ms ease-out; connector pulse 2.8s linear; respect prefers-reduced-motion

responsive.tablet: Stack hero copy above blueprint; decision cards wrap 3 + 2.
responsive.mobile: Hide nonessential nav behind menu; full-width actions; blueprint becomes a vertical source → bridge → SAP flow; decision cards become a vertical numbered list.

accessibility.logos: Meaningful alt text: Square and SAP
accessibility.diagram: Use a concise aria-label and preserve the same flow in DOM order.
